Title: Khazar Diary wraiths and the same unique minion

Messages.Author: Rehlow
Messages.Body:
I have Khazar's Diary up to 7 or more counters. I make a Vagabond
Mystic in my ash heap into a wraith. I then make a different Vagabond
Mystic in my ash heap into a wraith. Do they contest? I think they do
not contest. Shorb thinks they might.

Would it matter if one of them was a real Vagabond Mystic in play when
I try to put a Vagabond Mystic into play as a wraith? I think they do
not contest. I didn't ask Shorb about this one. ;)

Later,
~Rehlow

Card Text:

+1 stealth action.

Put the Diary in play, or add a counter to one in play. When a unique
minion in play is burned, add another counter. While this card has
seven or more counters, Giovanni get [NEC] and may take a +1 stealth
action to put a minion from any ash heap into play to represent a
wraith ally with 2 life, 0 strength, 1 bleed and +1 stealth.

Messages.Author: JJeff
Messages.Body:
> Card Text:
>
> +1 stealth action.
>
> Put the Diary in play, or add a counter to one in play. When a unique
> minion in play is burned, add another counter. While this card has
> seven or more counters, Giovanni get [NEC] and may take a +1 stealth
> action to put a minion from any ash heap into play to represent a
> wraith ally with 2 life, 0 strength, 1 bleed and +1 stealth.

I believe that the you put a minion from any ash heap into play TO
REPRESENT a wraith ally. It's not the ally. It's a wraith
So it's a non-unique wraith ally with no name.

This is opposed to the Spell of Life, where the mummy is unique
